items.title: Nepal floods explained: The chain of events behind the disaster
items.standfirst: A glacier broke apart. An ice and rock avalanche followed. Then came an earthquake, before a landslide triggered devastating floods that tore through kilometres of valley. FRANCE 24 breaks down the chain of events and the scientific explanations behind the disaster.
